question: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. sql:
WITH qualifying_records AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.BowlerID,
        ts.TourneyLocation,
        tm.MatchID,
        bs.GameNumber,
        bs.HandiCapScore,
        ts.TourneyDate
    FROM Tourney_Matches tm
    JOIN Tournaments ts ON tm.TourneyID = ts.TourneyID
    JOIN Bowler_Scores bs ON tm.MatchID = bs.MatchID
    WHERE ts.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
      AND bs.HandiCapScore IS NOT NULL
      AND bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
),
bowlers_at_all_three AS (
    SELECT BowlerID
    FROM qualifying_records
    GROUP BY BowlerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) = 3
)
SELECT 
    b.BowlerID,
    b.BowlerFirstName,
    b.BowlerLastName,
    qr.MatchID,
    qr.GameNumber,
    qr.HandiCapScore,
    qr.TourneyDate,
    qr.TourneyLocation
FROM bowlers_at_all_three ba
JOIN Bowlers b ON ba.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
JOIN qualifying_records qr ON qr.BowlerID = ba.BowlerID
ORDER BY b.BowlerID, qr.TourneyLocation, qr.MatchID, qr.GameNumber
